changeSet.sql: -- public.vw_facturacion_manual source CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_facturacion_manual AS WITH date_parse AS ( SELECT m_loan.id AS loan_id, CASE WHEN NULLIF(m_loan.closedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(m_loan.closedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(m_loan.closedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(m_loan.closedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(m_loan.closedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END AS parsed_closedon_date, CASE WHEN NULLIF(m_loan.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(m_loan.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(m_loan.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(m_loan.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(m_loan.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END AS parsed_firstrepayment_date FROM m_loan ) SELECT (mc.firstname::text || ' '::text) || mc.lastname::text AS nombre_titular_cuenta, id_type_cv.code_value AS tipo_identificacion, ccp."Cedula" AS numero_identificacion, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ml.expected_disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ml.expected_disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.expected_disbursedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ml.expected_disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.expected_disbursedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_desembolso, ml.principal_amount AS monto_prestamo, to_char(dp.parsed_closedon_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_cierre, mlrs.duedate AS fecha_cuota, COALESCE(mlrs.principal_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.principal_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS capital_pendiente, COALESCE(mlrs.interest_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.interest_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS interes_pendiente, COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS cargos_pendientes, COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS penalidad_pendiente, COALESCE(mlrs.principal_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.principal_completed_derived, 0::numeric) + (COALESCE(mlrs.interest_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.interest_completed_derived, 0::numeric)) + (COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric)) + (COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric)) AS total_pendiente, COALESCE(mlrs.principal_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS capital_pago, COALESCE(mlrs.interest_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS interes_pago, COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS cargos_pagos, COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS penalidades_pagas, COALESCE(mlrs.principal_completed_derived, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mlrs.interest_completed_derived, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0::numeric) AS total_pago, ml.number_of_repayments AS numero_coutas, COALESCE(mlrs.principal_amount, 0::numeric) AS capita_esperado, COALESCE(mlrs.interest_amount, 0::numeric) AS interes_esperado, COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_amount, 0::numeric) AS cargos_esperados, COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_amount, 0::numeric) AS penalidad_esperada, COALESCE(mlrs.principal_amount, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mlrs.interest_amount, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mlrs.fee_charges_amount, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(mlrs.penalty_charges_amount, 0::numeric) AS total_esperado, ml.principal_disbursed_derived - ml.principal_repaid_derived AS saldo_capital, ml.interest_charged_derived - ml.interest_repaid_derived AS saldo_interes, ml.fee_charges_charged_derived - ml.fee_charges_repaid_derived AS saldo_cargos, ml.penalty_charges_charged_derived - ml.penalty_charges_repaid_derived AS saldo_penalidad, ml.principal_disbursed_derived - ml.principal_repaid_derived + (ml.interest_charged_derived - ml.interest_repaid_derived) + (ml.fee_charges_charged_derived - ml.fee_charges_repaid_derived) + (ml.penalty_charges_charged_derived - ml.penalty_charges_repaid_derived) AS saldo_total, CASE WHEN mlaa.total_overdue_derived >= 30000::numeric AND (CURRENT_DATE - COALESCE(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived, CURRENT_DATE)) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE - COALESCE(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived, CURRENT_DATE) ELSE 0 END AS dias_mora, state_l.enum_value AS estado_credito, tipo_bloqueo.code_value AS tipo_bloqueo, mpl.name AS nombre_prestamo, ec.fecha_bloqueo, ec.reestructurado, tipo_garantia.code_value AS tipo_garantia, dg.porc_comision AS porcentaje, tipo_credito.code_value AS tipo_credito, estado_garantia.code_value AS estado_garantia, ia.codigo_promotor, ml.expected_maturedon_date AS fecha_esperada_fin, to_char(dp.parsed_firstrepayment_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS primer_pago FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_client mc ON ml.client_id = mc.id JOIN campos_cliente_persona ccp ON mc.id = ccp.client_id JOIN date_parse dp ON ml.id = dp.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value id_type_cv ON id_type_cv.id = ccp."Customer Identifier_cd_Tipo identificacion" LEFT JOIN "Informacion Adicional" ia ON ml.id = ia.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan mpl ON ml.product_id = mpl.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging mlaa ON ml.id = mlaa.loan_id LEFT JOIN r_enum_value state_l ON ml.loan_status_id = state_l.enum_id AND state_l.enum_name::text = 'loan_status_id'::text LEFT JOIN "Estado Cartera" ec ON ml.id = ec.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_bloqueo ON ec."Tipo Bloqueo_cd_Tipo Bloqueo" = tipo_bloqueo.id LEFT JOIN "Detalle garantia" dg ON ml.id = dg.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value estado_garantia ON dg."Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía" = estado_garantia.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_garantia ON dg."Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía" = tipo_garantia.id LEFT JOIN "Validacion Operacion" vo ON ml.id = vo.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_credito ON vo."Tipo Credito_cd_Tipo Credito" = tipo_credito.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule mlrs ON ml.id = mlrs.loan_id;
